notes:
- Company: IDE-first startup building a local-like copilot embedded in editors.
- Primary ask: sub-100ms TTFT for streaming first token on keystroke completions; steady-state throughput for 150 concurrent dev users.
- UX constraints: developer perceives lag >120ms as broken — target 50-80ms median, p95 < 120ms.
- Token budget: short completions (~16-64 tokens) for single-line suggestions; medium snippets up to 256 tokens. Want automatic per-context budget adjustment (cursor context, file size, recent tokens).
- Jitter/backpressure: need graceful backpressure when model slower than editor event rate — prefer token-level partial responses + local heuristics to synthesize placeholder suggestions.
- Model/version pinning: must be able to pin stable 8-bit quantized model for canary and stable channels; require fallback to smaller model when dedicated pool saturated.
- Observability: need per-request TTFT, per-token latency histogram, kernel selection traces; Redwood Console look promising.
- Security: SSO (SAML), audit logs, tenant isolation. Some enterprise customers will require EU residency.
- Quote from CTO on 2025-12-02: "If the first token doesn't feel instant, adoption collapse — we need predictable latency, not averages."
- Internal note: willing to pay for Dedicated if latency SLOs guaranteed; Private considered for large enterprise customers.
- Risk: competing in-house runtime evaluation and existing small-scale infra that they may try to scale internally.
- Suggested Redwood approach: start with Dedicated POC, apply Optimize suggestions (batching profiles tuned for short completions), enable prefix/KV caching for repeated tokens, and test deterministic backpressure policy for editor event bursts.

technical_requirements_summary: Low-latency streaming for editor completions: TTFT target median 50-80ms, p95 < 120ms. Token budgets: adaptive 16-256 tokens depending on completion type. Jitter tolerance: <20ms variance preferred; must support token-level partial streaming and graceful backpressure with deterministic fallback to smaller pinned models.
poa_notes: SE to run kernel selection matrix with short-seq microbenchmarks; test continuous batching disabled for immediate-mode completions; validate KV cache warmup on file open. Provide SOW draft for Dedicated pool with 99.9% availability and latency SLOs.
